metadata.speaker: Speaker 1 (with Companion)
metadata.overall_summary: The speaker and their companion are seated in a bustling public hall or cafeteria discussing wearable technology and eye wear. The speaker explains that they are using a headset camera display because they lost their regular glasses at a conference and navigating healthcare costs led them to use the device's optical inserts instead. They mention intending to disable the camera and demonstrate Gemini Live 2.5 before declining food because they ate a large oyster meal earlier, after which the companion leaves briefly to fetch hot water while ambient hall noise continues.
